Do mais aberto ao mais fechado. Cada deg: From the widest to the tightest. Each step answers a question.
Plano geral ou de estabelecimento: lugar: Establishing or extreme wide shot: place, mood and scale. In English, establishing shot or extreme wide shot. It opens the scene and sets the rules of the world.
Plano aberto: o corpo inteiro dentro do: Wide shot: the whole body inside the place. It shows isolation, danger or power through the relationship between the person and the space. In English, wide shot.
Plano americano, do joelho para cima: aç: Medium wide shot, from the knee up: action and body language. In English, medium wide shot or cowboy shot.
Plano médio, da cintura para cima: conve: Medium shot, from the waist up: conversation and neutral, realistic movement. In English, medium shot.
Close ou primeiro plano, o rosto: emoção: Close-up, the face: strong emotion, decision, fear, joy. The closer you get, the more the audience feels. In English, close-up; the middle ground is the medium close-up.
Plano detalhe: uma mão, um objeto, uma t: Detail shot: a hand, an object, a texture. It reveals the clue that changes the story. In English, extreme close-up or macro.
Regra de decisão: se o lugar ou a ação i: Decision rule: if the place or the action matters more, go wide; if the emotion matters more, go tight; if a detail changes the story, go to the detail.
Três decisões por plano, sempre pelo que: Three decisions per shot, always based on what the audience should feel.
aberto pergunta onde; fechado, como: wide asks where; close asks how
A wide shot answers "where are we?". A close shot answers "how does this feel?". The detail shows what changes the story.
Um caminho que funciona: abrir para most: A path that works: open wide to show the world, move in to reveal the emotion, and end on a close-up or detail for impact.
Plano geral da rua escura com a padaria: Wide shot of the dark street with the bakery lit up; medium shot of Dona Lia at the counter; close-up of her face lit by the oven.
Altura do olho é neutra. Câmera alta, ol: Eye level is neutral. A high angle, looking down, makes the character small or vulnerable. A low angle, looking up, makes them powerful or imposing.
Zenital dá uma visão de mapa; rente ao c: A top-down shot gives a map-like view; a worm's-eye view exaggerates height; a dutch angle (tilted camera) brings discomfort. Use the dutch angle rarely, or it loses its force.

Na prática, ângulo simples e bem justifi: In practice, a simple, well-justified angle comes out more stable than a rare one. If the rare one doesn't work, swap it for a simple one with the same intent.
Grande-angular abre o campo e exagera a: A wide-angle lens opens the field and exaggerates perspective: the place looks bigger. A telephoto lens narrows the field and compresses space: the background looks glued on and the subject is isolated.
Profundidade de campo rasa deixa só o su: Shallow depth of field keeps only the subject sharp and blurs the rest. It is a quiet way to say where to look (lesson 5).

Um quadro bonito em que o olho não sabe: A beautiful frame where the eye doesn't know where to go communicates nothing. Composition is deciding what you see first, where empty space works in your favor, and how foreground, midground and background separate. It's what makes a generated image feel like real space instead of a flat backdrop.

O que o público vê primeiro? Ele não dev: What does the audience see first? They shouldn't have to search: they should understand the scene in one second. If two elements compete for attention, one goes or loses light.
Regra dos terços: o sujeito fora do cent: Rule of thirds: the subject off-center creates a natural flow from the subject to the setting. Center and symmetry: balance, control, power, ritual.
A diagonal quebra a estabilidade e suger: The diagonal breaks stability and suggests movement, even when still. Leading lines (road, hallway, counter, shadow) lead the eye to the subject.
Mais espaço vazio: liberdade, escala, is: More empty space: freedom, scale, isolation. Less space: tension, tightness. Emptiness isn't a lack of content; it's the emotional content.
Frente: onde o público está. Meio: onde: Foreground: where the audience is. Midground: where the subject is. Background: where the context lives. Separate the three by focus, light, color or haze.

O erro que mais denuncia vídeo gerado é: The mistake that most gives away a generated video is a character who changes face, clothes, or hair from one shot to the next. The defense is a written sheet and a pack of reference images, decided before the first generation and repeated in every shot.

Idade, rosto, cabelo, corpo, postura. De: Age, face, hair, body, posture. A concrete, repeatable detail ("gray hair in a low bun"), not a loose adjective ("pretty"). Fictional character: nothing that looks like a real person.
A roupa da cena, com cor e material: \"a: The clothes in the scene, with color and material: "navy canvas apron over a white shirt". It doesn't change from one shot to the next.
O objeto que carrega a história: a pá de: The object that carries the story: the worn wooden peel, the key to the iron door. Described once, the same in every shot.
O lugar como estrutura dramática: o que: The place as dramatic structure: what's in it, what it's made of, what time it is. Setting and character are described separately and come together in the shot.
A lista curta do que não pode mudar entr: The short list of what can't change between shots: face, hair, clothes, prop, time of day. It goes into every prompt for the scene.
Imagens geradas uma vez, em estúdio neut: Images generated once, in a neutral studio: the character from the front, from the side and full-body; the wardrobe and the prop on their own; the empty setting. These are what the generators use as a reference.
A ficha é texto seu e vale para qualquer: The character sheet is your own text and works for any generator. How each tool receives the references is covered in course 1, lesson 5.

The generator doesn't remember the previous shot. What holds the character together is you repeating the same words in every prompt.
Por isso a ficha usa detalhe concreto: c: That's why the character sheet uses concrete detail: color, material, shape, a mark on the face. "Friendly" changes from shot to shot; "freckles on the nose and thin-rimmed glasses" doesn't.

Os geradores de 2026 aceitam várias imag: The 2026 generators accept several reference images to keep character, prop and style consistent. Dated examples (Oct/2026): Veo 3.1 accepts up to 3 images; Seedance 2.5, up to 30 images, 10 videos and 10 audios.

Personagem de ficção não pode parecer um: A fictional character can't look like a recognizable real person, nor use a real brand. An avatar with your own face only with your consent.

A cena em três ou quatro frases: quem, o: The scene in three or four sentences: who, where, what happens and how it ends. If you can't write the scene in four sentences, it isn't ready to become shots yet.
Apresentação, virada e fechamento. Na ce: Setup, turn and close. In a short scene, the arc fits in seconds: the first shot says where we are, the middle one brings the change, the last one leaves an image that works as a still.
Cada plano é uma linha numerada. Uma ide: Each shot is a numbered line. One idea per shot: if a shot does two things, it becomes two.

O que se ouve no plano: o ambiente do lu: What you hear in the shot: the ambience of the place, the effect of the action and the dialogue, if there is any. Written per shot, it goes into the prompt as a separate sentence.
A duração de cada plano. A soma tem de d: The duration of each shot. The total has to match the scene's duration; a contemplative shot lasts longer, an action shot lasts less.

Aceita, porque dois movimentos juntos de: It accepts it, because two movements together make the shot more dynamic.

Recusa, porque zoom não é movimento de c: It rejects it, because zoom is not a camera movement and can't appear.
Um movimento por plano: empilhar movimen: One movement per shot: stacking movements makes the camera fight itself and the result comes out unstable. Zoom is a lens movement and is valid on its own; the problem is combining the two.
